analysis:
Reviewed only docs/architecture/inference.md. The change adds roughly 147 lines of documentation at head lines 25-171 describing unregistered, internal Nemotron Super local paths, and touches head lines 868-869 (the base unit 9bceb6d953b336e2:4 starts at 829 and has no visible counterpart for the changed base line 721). No code or controls change.

Documented security behavior:
- Local-only bridge builder, binding and image binding. No model registration, no public media route, and no production caller for the optional HTTP hook.
- The optional HTTP hook reuses the authenticated local app, defaults to absent, and answers 429 queueFull before any response starts.
- Text-only prefix cache (NemotronSuperLocalPrefixCache) runs under DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY=1 using a resident recurrent checkpoint bank, a local unscoped cache scope, and no SSD tier. This is a resident-RAM path, whereas T-041 states production has no resident-RAM prefix tier. It is unregistered and has no production caller, so it is not a regression. If it is ever wired into production, T-041 (TTFT oracle, cross-tenant sharing, cacheSalt scoping) would need review, because the local unscoped scope bypasses coordinator-authored cacheSalt.
- Image ingress accepts only data:image/png and data:image/jpeg URIs, charges ingress and media before decode, and checks container limits before allocating raster buffers.
- MTP is opt-in via DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP=1 and refuses media.
- Memory admission and retention on native faults is documented (T-029, T-028 related).

No threat-model assumptions are invalidated. Documentation-only, so no code claims were verified against source. Later passes should confirm any code change in the same PR actually matches these claims, especially the prefix-cache scope and the HTTP hook auth.
